subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------SPT.GH.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 257 (PR.S(RD)II-11). ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the subject; SPT-GH (spiritual growth) is the partner. From the subject: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), TRS (transition) and PART (participation). From INDIV-TD: ATTN (attraction). From TRS: POL-DY (political dynamics). From PART: INFO-DY (information dynamics) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From ATTN: MOT-DY. From POL-DY: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From INFO-DY: AF-NT (affinity nature). From SOC-RT-DY: LG-EXT (logical extension).
